model_proposal.rationale: Target four internal nodes for coordinated contraction into sparse vacancy zones: node 7→[24,23] aligns vertically with fanins 0/1 and reduces edge [5,7] detour (current 9→LB 7); node 10→[22,24] places it directly above node 5’s new position, collapsing edge [5,10] to Manhattan-optimal 2 steps; node 8→[24,26] shortens both [4,8] and [7,8] to exact Manhattan (5 and 6 steps) while avoiding congested y=28; node 5→[22,22] frees the dense y=23 row and positions it closer to inputs 0/1/2 (y=20), reducing fanin routing overhead. All target coordinates lie in verified vacancy hotspots ([22,22], [24,23], [22,24], [24,26]) with no collisions. This realignment tightens the core without moving ports, targeting area reduction via internal density optimization—critical since right boundary is controlled by internal node 7 (currently x=27), and its leftward move to x=24 enables width reduction from 8 to 6 tiles if rerouting succeeds.
